reasoning.step1:
Document classification:
- Contains header "RECHNUNG" and invoice-like fields (Rechnungs-Nr., Rechnungs-Datum, Warenwert, Mehrwertsteuer, Endbetrag) → classify as invoice.
- No exclusion keywords ("Zahlungserinnerung"/"Mahnung") prominent → not excluded.

Locate candidate fields:
- Invoice date: line with "Rechnungs-Datum" shows "06.07.2023". Clear, use exactly as string "06.07.2023".
- Grand total / Endbetrag: bottom shows "Endbetrag ... 290,98" (EUR). This is the total payable.
- Net amount: "Warenwert in EUR 242,48" and labeled "Steuerpflichtig in EUR 242,48" — net amount is 242,48.
- VAT rate: "Mehrwertsteuer in % 20,00" → VAT rate is 20 (strip % per rules).
- VAT amount: "Mehrwertsteuer in EUR 48,50" → VAT amount is 48,50.
- Sender VAT ID: near top right "USt.-IdNr.: ATU45595404" under PAP STAR Österreich Vertriebs AG — this is sender VAT. Note recipient VAT also present ("Ihre USt-ID-Nr.: ATU22642807") but schema asks for Sender.VatId, so use ATU45595404.

Check for ambiguities / alternatives:
- Could net be interpreted as 242,48 vs subtotal of line items (190,80 + 51,68 = 242,48) — they match, so net confirmed.
- Grand total 290,98 equals 242,48 + 48,50 = 290,98, consistent.
- Ensure no other VAT rates present; only 20% shown → single VAT group.

No inference beyond explicit values. Number formatting: input uses comma as decimal separator; schema numeric fields require numbers and preserve decimal places — will convert to numeric with two decimals (e.g., 242.48) while keeping decimal precision.
